description.en: Comprehensive library of ready-to-use shadcn website blocks and UI sections.
description.zh: 收录数千款精巧的 shadcn/ui 完整页面区块与营销落地页组件集合。

content.en: shadcnblocks is a massive, meticulously structured repository of ready-made website blocks built entirely with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. Covering hero sections, bento grids, pricing matrices, feature showcases, and footers, it allows teams to rapidly construct conversion-optimized marketing pages.
content.zh: shadcnblocks 是目前规模庞大的开源 shadcn/ui 页面级区块代码库。完全遵循 Tailwind CSS 与 shadcn 结构规范，囊括了英雄区（Hero）、Bento 矩阵网格、多版本定价表、功能对比卡片与页脚等全套商业建站区块，支持直接拷贝源码加速产品落地。
